:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.5.12`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/useModernMathApis`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/prefer-modern-math-apis`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/prefer-modern-math-apis.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"useModernMathApis": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Use modern `Math` APIs for common mathematical operations.

Dedicated `Math` methods express mathematical intent directly and avoid reimplementing standard operations.
This rule recognizes logarithm conversions, sums of squares, and square roots of squared values.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
Math.log(x) * Math.LOG10E;
```

### Valid

```js
Math.log10(x);
Math.hypot(a, b);
Math.abs(x);
```
